Name: Harvey red tie
Author: Eli0630
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I don't know if anyone noticed, but for some reason in Harvey's portraits, his tie is an orange/brown color, which doesn't make sense when you see his sprites.
This mod fixes that detail, making Harvey's tie red in his portraits instead of brown/orange. 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install this mod along with Content Patcher and SMAPI, then put both mods in the SMAPI mods folder and it should work.
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Change Harvey's tie color to red to match the tie color of his sprites

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod requires:[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Content Patcher [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- SMAPI [/color]
